name: ongoing
description: Ongoing areas — work with no finish line, kept up rather than finished — kept in the area's README: /ongoing:new interviews for the desired state, the standards to keep, people, cadence and versioning; /ongoing:review checks the area against its standards and turns a slipped standard with a fix into a project; /ongoing:adopt gives an existing folder or long-running project the area's shape; /ongoing:pause sets an area dormant and /ongoing:drop archives one that is no longer relevant.
